nom: ANUA PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Capsule Mist

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe the mist as genuinely hydrating, especially in winter, though one dry/sensitive/acne-prone reviewer felt it added nothing beyond a hyaluronic serum and another with dry skin reported it made her skin oily and caused breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several say it is gentle, calming, and non-irritating even for reactive or rosacea-prone skin, while others report eye swelling and itchiness, red welts, itchy burning breakouts, or a rash after repeated use.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination/dry, sensitive, rosacea-prone and acne-prone skin found it lightweight yet hydrating, unlike heavier sprays that sit on the skin.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin found it hydrating without sacrificing the matte finish she wants, helping with blotchiness under makeup.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing themselves as perimenopausal or mid-40s report it as lightweight, hydrating, and suited to mature or changing skin, with one noting reduced fine lines and plumper skin.

concerns.aging: Reviewers in their 40s or perimenopausal describe the mist as lightweight and hydrating for mature skin, with one noting lessened lines and plumper, dewy skin; no dissent on this concern specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report strong, quick hydration, a glow, and relief from tightness or dryness, including one with dry winter skin and one with a compromised skin barrier who saw improved hydration; a few found it merely 'like water' with no noticeable hydrating effect.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with a damaged skin barrier and reactive skin reports the mist calmed redness and made skin look more even; another with rosacea-prone sensitive eyes had no issue with redness from the product itself, though eye-area reactions occurred in unrelated reviewers.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with a compromised skin barrier reports the mist calmed and hydrated her skin noticeably over regular use.
concerns.spots: One reviewer used it under concealer over acne and red spots and reports they looked mostly cleared by day's end, though this is a single, atypical report.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer states it is 'acne safe' and caused no breakouts while shrinking the look of pores, but multiple other reviewers, including some without a history of breakouts, report new pimples, rashes, or itchy burning breakouts after use.
concerns.oiliness: One dry-skin reviewer reports the product made her skin 'beyond oily' with more visible pores, and one other reviewer notes a slightly oily after-feel that fades in a few minutes; several others explicitly describe it as non-greasy.

aspects.libelle: Feels like plain water, no effect

extraits.texte: Horrible. I have dry skin, and this made my skin BEYOND oily. Additionally, i'm now breaking out all over my face and you can literally see every pore on my face. I gotta stop listening to the girls at the store who tell me what to buy lol.

Eyes swelled and were extremely itchy. I read hydrating and figured a far mist couldn't be so bad. But I reacted to some thin in it. The face mist might be hydrating but def not refreshing like most other face mists. Instructions say to close eyes but I don't recommend spraying on eyes. There are oils that clog your tear ducts. I have it a 3 because I haven't I've only used it for 3 days. I'll update after a month of use and not spraying near my eyes.

extraits.titre: Doesn't really add anything as a skincare product
extraits.texte: To preface: 30-something with dry, sensitive skin. Acne prone. Prone to redness. It is very gentle and did not irritate me. However, I feel like it honestly doesn't add anything to my skin routine. Honestly better off using a hylauronic serum.

extraits.titre: Love it more than I thought
extraits.texte: I have sensitive skin and I saw this being reviewed on TikTok so I bought it and at first I started using it when I would only do my make up and layer it in between each step. This gave me a great balance of hydration, especially because I have oily skin so I always wanna be matte. Sometimes I would get really blotchy and I feel like this helped me a lot especially with my moisturizer. I honestly recommend this product. I also started using it in my face routine after my toner and my skin loves it.

With so many products out there and with the marketing on them being so good you just never know what to trust or what you need for your specific skin. There was a makeup influencer who recommended this product and because I have messed up My skin barrier I am looking for all things hydration. And when I tell you I went through a half bottle in about a week and a half that is no exaggeration. I am SO happy that I tried this. Again you have to get what works for your skin, so I am just here to tell you my experience that it has calmed and hydrated my skin so nicely. I have even been using it on my neck and chest and I have seen huge improvements there is well. My skin is very sensitive and gets irritated very easily and this has made such a difference in calming down the redness, making my skin look calm and glowing, making it look more even and has worked nicely with my other products. I even spray it throughout the day when I feel my face is getting hot. I highly recommend if you are looking for pure hydration.

I didnt realize my skin needed this hydrating product. Saw it recommended online- gave it a go for the price. I have dry skin year round and this has helped hydrate my skin so much. Sensitive eyes due to rosacea but this product has not been an issue. Really happy to have found this product line.

I have senaitive and reactive skin, combo/dry, rosacea, acne prone, and facing weinkes at 48 - and this is amazing! Its lightweight but hydrating. Other sprays are heavy and sit on the skin - not this!
